$RNTX 
Rein Therapeutics Announces Preliminary Blinded Phase 2 RENEW Data Showing Encouraging Lung Function Trends in Patients with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis and Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

- Rein reported preliminary blinded Phase 2 RENEW lung-function observations in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis alongside third-quarter 2026 financial results. 

- Among 24 evaluable patients, 33% improved in forced vital capacity, a measure of exhaled air volume, at Week 12; changes ranged from a 338 ml improvement to a 349 ml decline. 

- Results pool LTI-03 and placebo recipients and do not establish a treatment effect. 

- No serious adverse events assessed as treatment-related were reported; 92% remained on or completed the study.

- Enrollment reached 90 of approximately 120 patients. 

- Rein expects topline results in 2027 and its $36.5 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities to fund operations into the first quarter of 2028. 

- -Third-quarter net loss narrowed to $5.537 million from $5.581 million a year earlier; research spending rose while administrative expenses fell.

A new study in @BMJOpen_Resp suggests that early-life exposure to #airpollution is linked to poorer lung function 🫁 in childhood, and that the difference persists into adolescence.

Researchers from the University of Copenhagen followed 846 mother-child pairs in the Danish COPSAC2000 and COPSAC2010 cohorts. They modelled exposure to PM2.5 and NO₂ during #pregnancy and the first year of life, and measured lung function from age 3 to 18. Each extra 2 µg/m³ of PM2.5 during pregnancy was associated with nearly 2% lower #lung capacity at age six, and higher exposure was linked to slower lung development through childhood and adolescence.

These effects showed up at relatively low levels. The average annual PM2.5 in the study was 9.6 µg/m³, compared with the @WHO guideline of 5 µg/m³. A

For one child the difference is small, but across a population even small shifts matter for #health. Protecting pregnant women and young children from polluted air is an early investment in lifelong lung health.
